turns.agent:
I couldn't make the poster. Magic Hour turned down the request because your account doesn't have enough credits, so no image was created and no credits were used.

What I was going to make:
- **Size:** tall (9:16) poster at 640px, the highest resolution on the free plan
- **Picture:** a busy outdoor night market with glowing lanterns, string lights, food stalls and crowds under a dark sky
- **Words:** only **NIGHT MARKET** as the headline and **SATURDAY 6–10 PM** underneath

Even the cheapest image models cost about 5 credits per image, so I'd need your balance to cover at least that. To go ahead, you can buy a credit pack or wait for your free credits to refill, then tell me and I'll make it with these settings.

One thing to know: image models sometimes misspell or garble words. If the text doesn't come out exactly right, I can try again or make the picture with no words so you can add the text yourself.
